label: Repacks
description: Finds FitGirl, DODI and ElAmigos releases, checks your linked games for new versions, and downloads them or opens their torrents.

permissions.reason: Reads the sites' search pages, release pages and release list
Opens a release's direct links in droidtop's browser view, where you go through the file host's page, so the download it starts can run in droidtop's Downloads
Tells you when a release you linked to a game has a new version
Releases you download are placed in your game folder
Hands magnet links to a torrent app you have installed (droidtop has no torrent client) and opens release and torrent-file pages in your browser
